data.name: Disaster Plan Z
data.detailed_description:
Steam Next Fest Demo Notice

The current Steam Next Fest demo for DisasterPlanZ is a shorter gameplay slice focused on shooting feel, combat

pacing, enemy pressure, and a boss encounter.

DisasterPlanZ has recently evolved from a more linear shooting and escape-focused stage game into a survival shooter

built around scavenging, base building, and defense. In the full version, the player is no longer simply running from

disaster and monsters. After enduring too many dark days of escape, the protagonist decides to stop retreating, build

a human survival settlement, and defend it against the creatures born from the disaster.

Because this new direction adds several major systems, the current demo does not yet include the full scavenging,

building, and defense loop. These systems are core parts of the full version, not delayed DLC or extra content. The

full scavenging system, base building system, defensive structures, defense combat, and more complete progression flow

will be completed before release and will not affect the planned launch timing.

This demo is intended to let players first experience the combat foundation of DisasterPlanZ: weapon feel, movement

pace, enemy pressure, and boss combat. Before release, we will continue updating the store page and related materials

to show more of the scavenging, building, defense, and long-term survival systems.

Stop running. Build a home. Defend humanity.

DisasterPlanZ is a single-player post-apocalyptic survival shooter built around scavenging, combat, base building, and

defense.

For too long, humanity has survived by hiding, fleeing, and losing ground to the disaster. The world is filled with

monsters created by the catastrophe, and every day of escape only leads to another night of fear. This time, the

protagonist chooses a different path: stop running, gather what remains, build a place where people can survive, and

hold the line against the disaster.

Scavenge, Build, Defend

Venture into dangerous areas to search for weapons, materials, supplies, and key resources. Every expedition is a

risk, but every resource you bring back can help strengthen the settlement and prepare for the next attack.

Build and upgrade your survival base with defensive structures, support facilities, and tactical improvements. Your

base is not just a shelter. It is the last place where people can stand together, recover, prepare, and fight back.

Fight the Disaster Monsters

Use a variety of weapons and upgrades to fight zombies, mutants, elite enemies, and powerful bosses. Enemies will

continue to pressure your defenses, attack from different directions, and force you to balance firepower, resources,

construction, and survival.

Your choices decide whether the settlement becomes another ruin, or the beginning of a new human stronghold.

Key Features

- Scavenge dangerous areas for weapons, materials, supplies, and survival resources.

- Build and upgrade a human survival settlement.

- Place and strengthen defensive structures to resist disaster monsters.

- Fight hordes of zombies, mutants, elite enemies, and powerful bosses.

- Upgrade weapons and abilities to create your own combat style.

- Balance exploration, resource gathering, construction, and defense.

- Stop running from the disaster and build a place where humanity can survive.
